integrity: Analytic derivation plus independently coded exact symbolic and finite rational tests; the finite tests are not universal proofs. No external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Exact degree-two spherical harmonics only; full intrinsic tangential gradients and fixed positive channel weight. No noise-model optimality or general other-degree theorem; unindexed earlier equivalents remain possible.
title: A minimal-node first-jet Parseval rule for spherical quadrupoles and unique tight latitude design
